image_description: A stocky, quadrupedal marsupial (wombat) with coarse grey-brown fur standing on rocky ground near a dark burrow entrance. The animal has a broad, blunt head, small eyes, and rounded ears. Its body is barrel-shaped and low to the ground. Short, powerful limbs are visible, particularly the forelimbs which appear robust. The background consists of green foliage and reddish flowers.
